biggest_catch: Transcription Hub publishes no pay rate, pay method, or pay schedule anywhere on its official freelancer pages — the only official pay statement is 'Based on the amount of work you complete, you will get paid by Transcription HUB,' with zero numbers; and files delivered late (over 24 hours) are denied payment entirely.
catches: Zero guaranteed tasks: you pick files from the marketplace up to an assigned pickup limit; nothing guarantees files will be available.
No official pay figure, method, or schedule is published for freelance/home-based transcribers — payment terms are not disclosed on the official evaluation FAQ or registration page.
You must pass the official evaluation process (register, transcribe assigned evaluation files, wait 24-48 hours for Quality Control review) before any live work.
Transcripts must be returned within 24 hours of pickup — 'Failing to deliver the files within 24 hours will qualify that Job to 'Over Due' and Payment for those Jobs will be denied.'
Variable task availability: your tier (Gold/Silver/Bronze, based on evaluation) gates access to the live marketplace; pickup limits can be raised or lowered.

Effective hourly pay can be low — and is unknowable in advance since no official rate exists; the Rs 12K-30K salaries on their full-time page are for India-based full-time employees, not freelancers, and must not be read as gig pay.
You must sign an NDA and a contract agreement before starting live work (official FAQ).

c1.evidence: Transcription Hub — brand of e24 Technologies LLC, headquartered in Issaquah, WA, USA (official full-time transcriber page). Real operating transcription company.

c2.evidence: Official pages confirm the freelancer opportunity: evaluation-transcriber FAQ and transcriber-registration page ('Transcription HUB invites transcribers and editors to join their remote freelance transcription team').

c3.evidence: No upfront fee is stated on the official freelancer pages; evaluation and registration are described as free. The full-time 'Fresher / Trainee' row lists 'None (Free Training)'.

c4.evidence: No official page publishes any concrete pay figure or pay mechanism for freelance transcribers: the registration page says only 'Based on the amount of work you complete, you will get paid by Transcription HUB' — no rate, no method, no schedule. The Rs 12K-30K salary table is explicitly for full-time employees, not marketplace freelancers.

eligibility: Official pages do not state country, age, or experience requirements for freelance/home-based transcribers — eligibility could NOT be confirmed officially. The evaluation test (transcribe assigned files to QC standards) is the stated gate. The full-time employee page lists Rs-denominated salaries, implying India-based hiring for those roles.
notes: Read live: transcriptionhub.com/evaluation-transcriber-faq (full text — registration steps, evaluation, 24-hour delivery rule with payment denial, NDA/contract) and transcriptionhub.com/transcriber-registration (full text — 4 steps: evaluated, rated Gold/Silver/Bronze, flexible work, 'Get Paid!'). Read search-result text of transcriptionhub.com/fulltime-transcriber (Rs salary table for full-time employees: Fresher free training; Transcriber Rs 12K-14K; Senior Rs 16K-18K; Direct Upload Rs 20K-25K; QC Rs 25K-30K). Could NOT confirm on official pages: any freelance pay rate, payment method, payment schedule, or eligibility criteria. Catalog $0 claim has no official figure to check against.
